current_dated_amendment.text:
The owner instructed the conductor to complete MILESTONES.md and follow its recommendations instead of asking when in doubt. The conductor therefore selects retaining the existing fail-closed shared CLI Runner digest rather than reverting its integrated validation. This is a new dated decision, not a retroactive claim that the original dirty task4 implementation had the same behavior.

For task4/R6 and its R18 preservation consumer, recognize only the existing shared-installation reuse of digestRunner. The retained original application.identity hashes os.ReadFile bytes; the integrated application.install reuses the existing doctor digest, rejects non-regular or non-executable Runner files, and retains its staged open/stat/hash/close failures and wrapping. Keep this exact existing hardening, its current rejection assertions and normal executable SHA256 identity. Original and current analysis both depend on reading/hashing the executable; no new analysis dependency is inferred. The actual debca5eb56e7719c566eb4552a04279631982671, a3b9f80efab9356c0be2080779133337e2471ac0 and ca334546 source/merge owners and original/current inputs must be retained as evidence.

This supersedes exact-original preservation only for that already-integrated validated-digest path. Preserve all other lazy discovery, installation precedence, private commands, command grammar/defaults, bytes, writer attempts/classification/status, comments and fixed supplied identities. Do not add a validator, change product code, recapture fixtures, relax another expectation or treat later-owner blame as a semantic waiver. The fn-114.11/.12 migrations retain their separate approved contracts. The only approved lint exception remains fn-109.28's two exact invariant-panic sites; no additional lint suppression follows. Native qualification and Linux CI remain deferred, with no PR, push or qualification pass.
